name: WW domain containing transcription regulator 1

function.text: WWTR1 encodes WW domain-containing transcription regulator protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Porocarcinoma; Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma; Skin-analogue primary poroid carcinoma of the head and neck. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
